newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pacific in China telecom venture.
newsitem.headline: First Pacific in China telecom venture.

text.p: First Pacific Co Ltd said on Wednesday a partly-owned unit has signed an agreement to help develop a mobile telephone network in southern China.

First Pacific said its 60 percent owned unit Shenzhen Merchant Link Communications Co Ltd signed a project cooperative contract to support China United Telecommunications Co Ltd in the construction of a GSM mobile telephone network in Shenzhen, Dongguan and Huizhou in Guangdong province.
China Merchants Holdings Ltd owns the other 40 percent of Shenzhen Merchant Link.
The first phase of the project was launched in Shenzhen on September 23 and has a total cost of approximately US$29 million, First Pacific said.
The network planning and layout of the second phase was underway and would be launched in late 1997, it added.
The project provides for network capacity of 180,000 subscribers.
